sql.companyFunction.getFunctions: select * from flow.company_function cf where cf.company_id = :companyId and cf.archived is not true
sql.companyFunction.getFunctionDetails: select cf.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(params))) FROM ( select cfp.id, case when cfp.company_function_id is null then cf.id else cfp.company_function_id end as "companyFunctionId", cfp.archived, cfp.default_value as "defaultValue", cfp.system_value_id as "systemValueId", sv.system_value as "systemValue", dfp.id as "dbFunctionParamId", dfp.db_function_id as "dbFunctionId", dfp.parameter_name as "parameterName", dfp.display_order as "displayOrder", dfp.parameter_data_type_id as "parameterDataTypeId", dfp.system_value as "isSystemValue", dfp.default_value as "isDefaultValue" from flow.db_function_param dfp left join flow.company_function_param cfp on cfp.db_function_param_id = dfp.id and cfp.archived is not true left join flow.system_value sv on sv.id = cfp.system_value_id where dfp.db_function_id = df.id and dfp.archived is not true order by dfp.display_order) params), '[]') AS "companyFunctionParams" from flow.company_function cf inner join flow.db_function df on df.id = cf.db_function_id where cf.id = :id
sql.companyFunction.updateCompanyFunctionPar: update flow.company_function_param set custom_field_group_id = :customFieldGroupId, default_value = :defaultValue, system_value_id = :systemValueId where id = :id
sql.companyFunction.insertCompanyFunctionPar: insert into flow.company_function_param (company_function_id, custom_field_group_id, default_value, system_value_id, db_function_param_id) values (:companyFunctionId, :customFieldGroupId, :defaultValue, :systemValueId, :dbFunctionParamId)
